support_spans: blurred vision and redness in her right eye

concepts.why: The combination of blurred vision, redness, and significant visual acuity impairment in one eye, in the context of a systemic infection, could suggest a diagnosis of systemic lupus erythematosus, although the lack of relevant medical history and normal laboratory tests make this less likely.
It explains the negative CSF SARS-CoV-2 RT-PCR finding in the context of optic neuritis and retinal vasculitis.
